prompt:
Return this document exactly as given, with tags around the spans listed below. Do not change, omit, reorder or add any text. Do not paraphrase. Do not fix typos. If a field is not present, do not tag it. Never nest one tag inside another. Output only the tagged document (no preamble, no code fence, no commentary).

Document type: licensor_email

Tags to use (wrap the span that IS the value; keep the label text outside the tag):
- <email_date>: the date the email was sent (the Date header)
- <sender_address>: the sender's email address
- <grant_statement>: the sentence in which the licensor grants, confirms or extends permission
- <granted_work_title>: the title of the work the permission refers to (title only)
- <granted_use_scope>: the words describing the scope of the permission (e.g. monetised videos on your channel)
- <granted_channel>: the channel or video the permission names, if any
- <ticket_ref>: the support ticket reference, if any

Worked example 1 (a receipt):
--- input ---
Order date: 19 August 2025
Order ID: GA-2025-08231
Item: Glasslight — Standard licence
--- output ---
Order date: <purchase_date>19 August 2025</purchase_date>
Order ID: <order_id>GA-2025-08231</order_id>
Item: <purchased_work_title>Glasslight</purchased_work_title> — <licence_tier>Standard</licence_tier> licence

Worked example 2 (a licence document with numbered clauses; one tag per clause, clause number as an attribute):

4. Uses
4.1 The licence permits use of the Work in podcasts.

From: Glasswork Audio Support <support@glasswork.audio>
To: Leo Marsh <leo@leomarshmusic.example>
Date: Tue, 02 Sep 2025 10:14:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Using Glasslight on my monetised channel
Message-ID: <GW-SUP-55120.20250902@glasswork.audio>

Hi Leo,

Thanks for checking before you publish, and congratulations on the channel growth.

We've looked at your order GA-2025-08231 (Glasslight — Standard licence, issued 19 August 2025). You're right that the Standard tier under our current terms covers non-commercial use only. As a goodwill gesture for an existing customer we're happy to sort this out without an upgrade fee.

We've extended your licence: you're cleared to use Glasslight in monetised ClipStream videos on your channel Leo Marsh Music.

This extension is recorded against your order on our side. If a content-matching claim is raised on a video that uses the track, reply to this email with the case reference and we will ask our administrator to release it.

Ticket reference: GW-SUP-55120

Best,
Priya
Glasswork Audio Support
support@glasswork.audio

> On 1 Sep 2025, at 18:42, Leo Marsh wrote:
> Hi, I bought a Standard licence for Glasslight a couple of weeks ago. I'm about to publish a full live set with ads on. Am I covered, or do I need Pro?
